targets.descriptor: Front print is a two-part placed system stacked centrally: a wide serif wordmark reading GUCCI spanning nearly the full chest width across the upper chest, and beneath it a much larger roundel of two overlapping outlined circles forming interlocking double-G shapes, whose outer edges reach close to the side seams and drop past mid-body. The neck opening is notably broad and shallow, finished with a narrow self/rib binding rather than a deep band, and a small pale woven brand label with a red-and-green tab sits at the inside back neck, legible through the opening. Short set-in sleeves are cut with a plainly stitched straight edge and the body ends in a plain turned hem with a single visible topstitch line, so the piece reads as a soft jersey shell with no trims other than the print. Shown unworn and laid out, so how the shoulder line and body relate to a wearer cannot be established.
